sentences.text: After hearing counsels for parties, the review application is allowed and following is added after the words '.......was issued.'

in paragraph 11 of the order dated 23.01.2023:-
"The authority shall grant compensation at par to the compensation granted with regard to the respective villages for their land acquired as per the notification for the said period and in case no notification is issued for any village then as per the notification issued and compensation granted to farmers in the nearest village.".

After addition, new paragraph-11 of the order dated 23.01.2023 reads as under:-
"11. I find force in fair submission of learned counsel for the petitioners.
Though, rest of the villagers have already got their compensation but petitioners are still fighting for their claim.
The amount of compensation granted to the petitioners, as noted above, is abnormally low.
Hence, the prayer of the petitioner is allowed.

The respondents are directed to calculate the compensation payable to the petitioners on the basis of market value of the land prevailing on the date on which the notification for compulsory acquisition under Section 4 of the Act of 1894 for the relevant villages was issued.

The authority shall grant compensation at par to the compensation granted with regard to the respective villages for their land acquired as per the notification for the said period and in case no notification is issued for any village then as per the notification issued and compensation granted to farmers in the nearest village.
Along with the same, as directed by this Court in Durga Prasad case (supra), the petitioners shall also be entitled for solatium, interest etc. calculated accordingly from the same date.

The respondents are directed to calculate the compensation payable to the petitioners on the basis of the aforesaid directions and pay the same to the petitioners within a period of six weeks from today.
The judgments dated 15.09.2015, 01.10.2015, 08.10.2015 and 20.04.2017 passed by learned Additional District Judge, Bhadohi, Gyanpur stand modified as per above."

Order Date :- 23.3.2023/Arti- [Vivek Chaudhary,J.]
